title: AttemptRecord
description: One execution attempt: compute status, supervision and provenance. Its MLflow run is keyed by attempt_id.

attempt_id.title: AttemptId
attempt_id.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

state.title: AttemptState
state.description: Compute status of one attempt. `unknown`: the collector vanished without reporting an exit; nothing is rerun automatically.

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

started_at.title: Timestamp
started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

ended_at.title: Timestamp
ended_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

cancel_requested_at.title: Timestamp
cancel_requested_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

mode.description: `systemd`: a user scope per attempt. `direct`: a plain process group (no systemd user manager). `remote`: the target's own supervisor (`remote.target_kind`).

enforcement.description: Whether CPU/memory/task limits are enforced by the kernel (spec §7.11). Never claim enforced for direct mode.

container.title: AttemptContainer
container.description: The job container a contained session's local attempt ran in (ADR 0061).

mounts.description: Hidden paths mounted read-only for a protected evaluation.

collector.title: CollectorHealth
collector.description: Last health report from the attempt's collector.

last_seen_at.title: Timestamp
last_seen_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

snapshot.title: AttemptSnapshot
snapshot.description: Provenance captured when the attempt started (spec §6).

path.description: Path inside the run's artifact root.

uploaded_at.title: Timestamp
uploaded_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

remote.title: RemoteAttemptInfo
remote.description: Remote execution, connectivity and sync status of one attempt.

target_id.title: TargetId
target_id.description: Compute target identifier (lowercase slug). `local` is reserved for this machine.

target_kind.title: TargetKind
target_kind.description: `ssh`: a worker host reached over SSH (usually on the tailnet). `slurm`: a cluster login node reached over SSH; jobs go through `sbatch`. `runpod`: pods through the Runpod REST API. `colab`: Google Colab runtimes, unattended through Google's Colab CLI (`colab.mode: cli`) or as an exported notebook a person runs (`notebook`).

staging.title: RemoteStaging
staging.description: `submitted`: the provider confirmed the job; from here the provider's scheduler owns process lifetime (spec §5.7). `exported`: a notebook was written for an interactive runtime (Colab); nothing runs unattended, and results arrive by `remote import` (or live, if the notebook was exported with credentials).

submitted_at.title: Timestamp
submitted_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

provider_checked_at.title: Timestamp
provider_checked_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

first_contact_at.title: Timestamp
first_contact_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

last_contact_at.title: Timestamp
last_contact_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

connectivity.title: RemoteConnectivity
connectivity.description: `pending`: the worker has not called in yet. `disconnected`: no heartbeat within `remote.disconnected_after_sec`; live monitoring and cancellation are not guaranteed.

sync.title: RemoteSyncStatus
sync.description: Worker-to-coordinator sync, shown separately from compute status (spec §5.3). `synced`: the worker reported its exit and an empty spool.

spool_acked_seq.description: Highest worker spool seq the coordinator has applied; returned in the handshake so the worker replays only what is unacknowledged.

reconcile_required.description: Why the outcome is ambiguous (a second worker, a lost process, a provider that ended the job). Nothing is rerun; a human decides.

launch_expires_at.title: Timestamp
launch_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

store_slots.description: Presigned S3 upload slots issued to the worker (settings `remote.artifact_store`). Slot `n` is the object `<prefix><project>/<attempt>/s<nn>`.

store_cleaned_at.title: Timestamp
store_cleaned_at.description: When the attempt's leftover store objects were deleted after sync.

imported_at.title: Timestamp
imported_at.description: When a spool archive was last imported (`remote import`): the worker reported offline, never live.

expected_back_by.title: Timestamp
expected_back_by.description: An exported attempt (Colab): when its results should be back, the export time plus the job's time limit plus `remote.export_slack_min`. Absent without a time limit. Passing it makes the attempt overdue; nothing fails it automatically.

overdue_at.title: Timestamp
overdue_at.description: When the coordinator saw an exported attempt still unreported after `expected_back_by`. Import its archive, or mark it lost.

marked_lost_at.title: Timestamp
marked_lost_at.description: When a researcher marked an exported attempt lost (`remote resolve JOB --lost`): it ended `unknown`, releasing its parallel slot. A late import still lands and settles it.

compute_units.title: ColabComputeUnits
compute_units.description: A Colab runtime's compute units (`colab.mode: cli`, ADR 0059), in hundredths as Colab reports them. Units used are about `per_hour_hundredths` / 100 times the hours from `allocated_at` to `released_at` (or now): an estimate from the account's rate, which Colab reports for the whole account, not per runtime.

per_hour_hundredths.description: The runtime's compute units per hour, in hundredths: how much the account's hourly rate rose when it was allocated (0 on a free runtime).

balance_at_allocation_hundredths.description: The account's balance, in hundredths, just before the runtime was allocated.

allocated_at.title: Timestamp
allocated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

released_at.title: Timestamp
released_at.description: When the coordinator stopped the runtime (or found it gone).
